turns.text:
{"sql": "
WITH q AS (
  SELECT cust_id,
    CASE WHEN sold_on < '2025-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
         WHEN sold_on < '2025-07-01' THEN 'Q2'
         WHEN sold_on < '2025-10-01' THEN 'Q3'
         ELSE 'Q4' END AS qtr
  FROM pos_sales
  WHERE sold_on >= '2025-01-01' AND sold_on < '2026-01-01'
),
all4 AS (
  SELECT cust_id FROM q GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT qtr) = 4
),
y2026 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM pos_sales WHERE sold_on >= '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT c.cust_id, cu.name, cu.email
FROM all4 c
LEFT JOIN y2026 y ON c.cust_id = y.cust_id
JOIN customers cu ON cu.cust_id = c.cust_id
WHERE y.cust_id IS NULL
ORDER BY cu.name;
"}
